meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制Claude的记忆模式,让重要内容按场景自动记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望Claude按场景记住关键信息并提醒你
copy.tagline_en: Create custom memory modes so Claude tracks what matters by scenario
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Claude to remember key details per scenario and remind you

howto.what: Claude 会先访谈你做什么工作,提出一套观察类型和概念标签,经你确认后安装并激活自定义 claude-mem 模式,可选配置 Telegram 提醒,再重启 worker 并验证模式已在启动上下文生效。
howto.when: 当你想自定义 claude-mem 记住的内容、创建或修改模式,或为特定记忆加 Telegram 通知时触发,即使你没说「模式」二字。

say.text: 帮我建一个自定义模式,用来跟踪我的案件笔记
say.note: Claude 会先问你做什么工作,再提分类方案

say.text: 我想改一下 claude-mem 记录的东西,加几个观察类型
say.note: 会先给出现有模式供你复用或改写

say.text: 给生产事故这类记录加 Telegram 提醒
say.note: 会先请你确认要提醒的类型或标签

howto.what_en: Claude interviews you about your work, proposes observation types and concept tags, then installs and activates a custom claude-mem mode once you approve it. It can also set up Telegram alerts, restart the worker, and verify the mode is active.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, or add Telegram alerts for particular memories—even if you don't say "mode."

say_en.text: Create a custom mode to track my case notes
say_en.note: Claude first asks what you work on

say_en.text: I want to change what claude-mem records and add observation types
say_en.note: It shows existing modes to reuse or remix

say_en.text: Add Telegram alerts for production incident notes
say_en.note: It asks which types or tags to alert on
